On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Westridge Burnaby Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Westridge sits on the western slope of Burnaby Mountain, split in two by Inlet Drive, with Burrard Inlet to the north and Hastings Street at its southern edge.

blocks.text: Westridge Burnaby Houses: the housing stock

items.t: Inlet Drive divides two eras: west, a typical 1950s single-family subdivision; east, a 1970s subdivision with larger lots and some low-rise units.

blocks.text: Westridge Burnaby Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Slope is a planning rule here: Burnaby's 2050 policy guide says steep slopes are managed through Development Permit Areas (DPAs), restricting development on them and varying setbacks at slope tops.
A geotechnical report is required only if a property is flagged as floodplain or slope instability area, per the City's application form.
Lots near a stream or ravine can trigger a Streamside Protection Development Permit, needing an Environmental Assessment Report by a Qualified Environmental Professional.

blocks.text: Westridge Burnaby Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Barnet Marine Park parking is restricted May 1 to September 30 on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays; the City counts over 1,900 daily visitors and about 1,000 vehicles per day in summer.

blocks.text: Westridge Burnaby Houses: development and new projects

items.t: Burnaby 2050 Official Community Plan, city-wide, City of Burnaby: adopted December 9, 2025, replacing the 1998 plan, and now the long-term land-use framework Westridge lots are read against. Status: adopted (as of November 3, 2026).
TransLink route 160 runs along Inlet Drive through Westridge, between Kootenay Loop and Port Coquitlam Station, per TransLink's Burnaby and New Westminster system map.
Hastings Street, at the neighbourhood's south edge, carries the R5 rapid bus toward downtown Vancouver and SFU Exchange, per the same TransLink map.

blocks.text: Westridge Burnaby Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the slope-instability flag for the exact lot before assuming a rebuild: the flag, not the street, decides whether Burnaby requires a geotechnical report.
Check the Streamside Development Permit Area for lots near a ravine or watercourse: a Qualified Environmental Professional's report must confirm the setback boundary first.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Westridge?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 10 houses listed in Westridge. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Westridge a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Westridge had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Westridge from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 4 houses sold in Westridge over those 5 months, out of 251 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Westridge?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: Is the west side of Westridge the same as the east side?
faq.a: No. Inlet Drive divides the neighbourhood into a 1950s single-family subdivision to the west and a 1970s subdivision with larger lots and some low-rise units to the east, so lot size, house era and street pattern all change at Inlet Drive.

faq.q: Does the slope change what I can build?
faq.a: On flagged lots, yes. Burnaby's policy is to restrict development on steep slopes through Development Permit Areas and vary setbacks at slope tops, and the City requires a geotechnical report where a property is flagged for slope instability or floodplain.

Westridge Elementary, at 510 Duncan Avenue, kindergarten to Grade 7, is the neighbourhood school on the Province's Burnaby list. Burnaby School District No. 41 (SD41) states that its School Locator finds the school a child can attend based on the home address, so confirm the exact address there.

faq.q: What is at Barnet Marine Park, below Westridge?
faq.a: The City describes it as a foreshore park on Burrard Inlet with a sandy beach, launch facilities for canoes, kayaks and sailing craft, shore fishing with a valid licence, a seasonal cafe, picnic areas, playgrounds, and a designated dog off-leash area.

faq.q: What did houses in Westridge sell for?
faq.a: 9 houses sold in Westridge between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,840,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Westridge?
faq.a: The median was 51 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 92.7% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
